Copied unmodified from github.com/mikevocalz/virocore (MIT, see the virocore
LICENSE), branch feat/panel-corners-compositor, commit d5e219c18490ce8df8b4718e02de4c4516b61077:

  VRORivePanel.h     android/sharedCode/src/main/cpp/VRORivePanel.h
  VROPanelCoverage.h ViroRenderer/VROPanelCoverage.h

VRORivePanel.h declares the exported C++ API of libviro_renderer.so that the
Rive HybridObjects call. VROPanelCoverage.h is header-only and gives the
corner radii the Viro consumer rounds with, so pointer hits use the same ones.

Both must match the libviro_renderer.so the app ships. Check with:

  VIROCORE_ROOT=/path/to/virocore pnpm --filter @viro-external/native-panels test

test/vendored-virocore-headers.test.mjs compares these files byte for byte
against that checkout.
